Keywords

Can include contract title, description, buyer and supplier

  • To search for any of the keywords, use an OR search. For example, radio television

  • To search for all the keywords, use an AND search by placing a + with no spaces. For example, administration+defence

  • To search for a phrase or exact match, use quotes. For example, "Department of Health"

  • Early engagement - a procurement idea in the early stages of development, judging interest from potential suppliers

  • Future opportunity - prior notification of an upcoming opportunity, some dialogue may be possible but bids are not yet invited

  • Opportunity - the buyer is looking for potential suppliers to fulfil the contract, accepting bids until the closing date/time

  • Awarded contract - a contract has been awarded to a supplier
